lineage_rule: AI-origin is bound to semantic_asset_id/master lineage, not to file extension. AI raster -> SVG/EPS/PSD/PNG remains AI-origin and must carry disclosure everywhere.

policies.notes: Raster photo lane: single JPG sufficient. Min 4MP.
Raster lane: JPG priority. Min 3MP. AI faces generally rejected.
Photo JPG sRGB min 4MP. Vector lane separate (EPS).
Photos/vectors/PSD accepted with AI tag. EPS/PSD containing AI elements still AI-origin.
Regular image JPEG min 6MP. No high-repetition variants.
AI and traditional content cannot mix in one account. No editorial use for AI.
AI-generated contributor content not accepted for licensing. Vectorize/PSD does not change origin.
Contributors may not submit external AI-generated content for licensing (policy updated 2025-07-16 per founder matrix).
Production/recovery (upscale) service, not a licensing marketplace. Never a submission route.

authority.meaning: READY_FOR_MANUAL_SUBMISSION means the Founder may upload the single JPG manually after QC/rights clearance. It is NOT an automated COMPATIBLE/PASS claim and MUST NOT unblock package-readiness without human gates.
